title: The Sap Trees
text: A grove of pale trees that bleed a golden sap from every crack in their bark. It runs thick and slow and smells of honey and something like blood. Alchemists pay well for it. The trees shiver when they are cut.

options.label: Tap the trees for sap. Alchemists pay well for gold that bleeds.

outcomes.text: Jars of it, warm and golden, and the trees shiver for each one.

options.label: Fell the pale trees, and take timber and sap both.

outcomes.text: Timber and sap both, and a sound from each trunk as it falls.

options.label: The wisest takes seedlings for the House, to grow a grove of its own.

outcomes.text: A grove, in time, that bleeds gold. Nobody likes to walk in it after dark.
